title: Live NotNotes intentions and authority boundaries
summary: AlchemyNotNotesIntentions is a missing source dependency in the published Help Desk. Preserve live application discovery and separate recognition, applicability, feasibility, authorization and dispatch.
invariants: The intention catalogue is not an immutable LLM tool list or startup snapshot.
A currently infeasible but recognized business operation remains understood; do not relabel it UNKNOWN.
Business intentions have priority over read-only instrumentation specialist requests.
The Help Desk may present decisions but does not own application mutation authority.
The actual AlchemyNotNotesIntentions.cls definition and method contracts must be quoted only after exact source recovery.
procedure: Resolve and publish the authentic AlchemyNotNotesIntentions.cls versioned source and required package dependencies.
Inspect the actual provider/catalogue class rather than reverse-engineering method names from downstream usage.
Use current semantic application/document projections for per-request discovery and feasibility.
Run complete end-to-end ooRexx tests with real NotNotes and Intention Service classes, including runtime-added formats/reports and authorization failures.

provenance.claim: Consumer requires AlchemyNotNotesIntentions.cls and MiniNotesApp.cls but the class sources are not published in this repository.
Describes per-turn dynamic discovery, business first refusal and live semantic projections.
